head: 10 new travel apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These travel apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Travel charts this week, from a gas price finder and Connecticut's mobile ID to translators, cruise port guides and a plane radar.
where: iPhone (some also iPad, Mac or Apple Watch), US App Store Travel charts (paid, plus Connecticut Mobile ID in free) this week
means: If you're planning a road trip, a cruise or a trip abroad, these are the new travel apps people in the US are downloading right now, most for a one-time price under $10.
todo: Read the App Store page first: Connecticut Mobile ID is a companion to your physical ID, which the state says to keep carrying, and RV Site Snag is only for Thousand Trails members and doesn't book sites itself.

list.name: GasSavvy
list.what: Ranks nearby gas stations by what a full tank costs you after discounts you already have, like Walmart+, Shell Fuel Rewards or AAA.

list.name: Connecticut Mobile ID
list.what: Connecticut's official state mobile ID, a companion on your phone to your driver license or ID card.

list.name: PS Speak: Voice Interpreter
list.what: Translates a conversation between two people out loud with split-screen captions, and turns talks or announcements into captions.

list.name: RV Site Snag
list.what: For Thousand Trails members: works out the night a booking window opens for your membership level and park, and reminds you before it opens.

list.name: Private Location History
list.what: Keeps a private timeline of the places you visit, saved on your device and your own iCloud, with iPad and Mac apps to look through it.

list.name: Waypoints: Travel Log
list.what: Saves restaurants, hotels and sights you've found or want to try, sorted into trips with your photos, notes and a love, like or dislike mark.

list.name: Port Things: Cruise Port Guide
list.what: Offline guides to cruise ports and places like Cozumel, Nassau and Iceland; the price includes five guides, more cost extra.

list.name: Planescope: Live Air Traffic
list.what: Shows the planes flying around you on a live radar that turns with your phone, with each flight's airline, aircraft and route; the Mac app is included.

list.name: BADè Translator : Reader
list.what: Point the camera at a menu, street sign or pharmacy label and see the translation placed on the photo, in more than 30 languages.

list.name: Guide To Tromsø
list.what: A northern lights guide for Tromsø in Norway from local aurora guides, with live aurora data, a cloud cover map and viewing spots.
